intended_behavior_phases: Phase 1: Stabilize and orient lander upright while descending toward pad.
Phase 2: Controlled descent with main engine throttling to reduce vertical speed near ground.
Phase 3: Final touchdown with both legs contacting ground, minimal lateral velocity, and upright orientation.

component_scale_reasoning.objective_success_bonus: Large sparse bonus (100) for successful landing (both legs contact, upright, on pad, low speed) to clearly signal task completion.
component_scale_reasoning.shaping_progress: Moderate shaping rewards for reducing distance to pad (x,y) and vertical speed, scaled to provide dense feedback without dominating the objective bonus.
component_scale_reasoning.fuel_penalty: Small penalty (-0.1 per unit m_power) to encourage fuel efficiency without discouraging necessary engine use.
component_scale_reasoning.crash_penalty: Large penalty (-100) for crashes or out-of-bounds to strongly discourage failure.
component_scale_reasoning.orientation_regularizer: Small penalty for large angle or angular velocity to encourage upright posture.
component_scale_reasoning.leg_contact_bonus: Small bonus (+10) when both legs contact ground to reinforce proper landing posture.

initial_reward_template: active objective signal: success_bonus (100) when both legs contact, upright, on pad, low speed
reachable progress signal: shaping_reward for reducing distance to pad and vertical speed
diagnostic terms: distance_to_pad, vertical_speed, horizontal_speed, angle, angular_velocity, leg_contact, m_power, s_power, crash_penalty, success_bonus
